company.name: MUAB
company.description:
MUAB is the platform powering the Knowledge Economy, transforming expertise into opportunity. We enable creators, students, professionals, and enterprises to share insights, monetize digital products, and scale with intelligent business tools.
Core Features
Knowledge-first posts: Publish videos, images, PDFs, and shorts to build credibility and thought leadership.
Digital product marketplace: Launch and sell courses, guides, templates, and bundles with ease.
Feedback-driven ads: Deliver respectful, insight-rich campaigns that reward users while providing organizations with actionable intelligence.
The Octopus System
MUAB’s integrated business suite gives members everything required to grow:
Product Arm: Build and package digital products efficiently.
Finance Arm: Manage revenue streams and payouts securely.
Marketing Arm: Deploy AI-powered campaigns to reach and engage communities.
Analytics Arm: Transform data into insights that drive strategic scaling.
Growth Pathway
From solo learners to global enterprises, MUAB provides a scalable journey:
Build credibility through knowledge-first sharing.
Monetize expertise through digital product creation and sales.
Scale intelligently with advanced tools, analytics, and organizational management.
Vision
To become the global hub of the Knowledge Economy — where knowledge, technology, and business management converge to empower millions of learners, creators, and enterprises worldwide.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $200,000, or 66.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,416,720 to $3,473,071, a 1.44x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 93 (+29 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (+2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
